description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for git rebase operations across mode changes. It sets up repositories, commits, branches, and performs rebase tests using different backends and options, verifying behavior in various rebase scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a set of shell commands to execute.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup command to run after the test case finishes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, indicating all tests have been defined.
